title: Synth reads Vault but never writes candidates back
context: 21-vault.js only counts Vault rows for the model chip (public anon key in 00-config.js). The Save to Vault button described in the README is a placeholder "pending a schema decision on candidate tagging"; NEXT-UP still lists it.

options.name: Read-only (current)
pros: Training data stays clean of model guesses
No write credentials in a static page
cons: The lineage loop in the README is not closed
Good candidates are lost unless sent through Queue or Mesh by hand

options.name: Write candidates tagged as model-generated
options.summary: Insert rows marked unvalidated, excluded from training until a sweep characterizes them.
pros: Closes the loop; seeds future sweeps
cons: Needs a Vault schema field and a trainer filter
Write access from a public page

options.name: Route candidates through F13LD.queue to Sweep
options.summary: Use the existing Queue hand-off as the only path back.
pros: No Vault schema change; only validated results reach Vault

recommendation: 21-vault.js is read-only; README "The data lineage loop" says the button is mocked pending a schema decision.

log_refs.entry: The data lineage loop: Save-to-Vault mocked pending schema decision
Ideas: Save to Vault is still a placeholder
